messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — hosted-runtime: KV cache OOM surge detected on continuous-batching path. Root ts: 1793214567. Affected pods: gen-hosted-5xx (4/12). @sasha you're oncall.

sasha (oncall): I'm taking it. seeing repeated OOMs on gen-handler where kv_cache.window_size spikes to 1.6M tokens.

maria (eng-sre): Confirmed metrics — OOM count jumped at 15:02 UTC, 120 OOMs/min, error rate +2.6% for /v1/generate. CPU OK, memory blown by KV cache growth.

sasha (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) disable continuous batching on hosted pool, 2) apply soft eviction to kv cache (max_window -> 65536 -> 8192), 3) temporarily throttle long-context requests. Doing step 1 now.

sasha (oncall): Run: `rbctl config set hosted.continuous_batching.enabled=false --pool hosted-gen` -> applied.

derek (eng-runtime): Good. Also push a hotfix to kv cache pager that enforces per-request max_kv_window. I can push a runtime flag: `--kv-max-window=65536` and hot-restart the runtime.

sasha (oncall): Applying soft eviction: `rbctl secrets set KV_CACHE_MAX_WINDOW=8192 --env hosted` then rolling restart gen-hosted-*

ops-runbook-bot: recommended checklist: mute noisy customers, enable throttles, collect full heapdump if OOM persists.

emily (support): Heads up to affected customers: some LLM endpoints returning 503s for long prompts. CS drafting a brief template.

maria (eng-sre): After disabling batching and eviction, OOM spikes dropped from 120/min to 6/min in 3 minutes. Error rate back down 0.3% above baseline. Latency still elevated for some requests.

derek (eng-runtime): Hotfix deployed: runtime flag enforced, also added direct eviction of KV entries older than 60s. Rolling restarts completed across 6/12 hosts.

sasha (oncall): Throttle rule applied at edge for paths `/v1/generate` where token_length>20000 -> return 413 with user-friendly msg. `edgectl rate-limit add ...`

emily (support): Notifying top 10 affected orgs with ETA ~30m for full recovery. Template posted in #support-ops.

maria (eng-sre): Metrics check: memory usage normalized, KV window median down from 400k tokens -> 4k tokens. OOMs now near zero. Confirming no data loss.

sasha (oncall): Doing quick canary: re-enable continuous batching on a single canary host with stricter kv-max-window=4096 to measure perf.

derek (eng-runtime): Canary looks OK for short prompts; perf cliff avoided. We'll move continuous batching re-enable behind a feature flag that includes kv-window guard.

sasha (oncall): Incident -> severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 at 15:42 UTC. root cause: runaway context windows from a small set of customer requests combined with continuous batching not enforcing per-request KV window limits.

maria (eng-sre): Postmortem TODOs: 1) add autoscale fallback for kv memory, 2) ship permanent guard in runtime, 3) add telemetry to identify runaway prompts early, 4) update runbooks for hosted.

sasha (oncall): Handoff to @derek for the morning: follow-ups assigned in JIRA (INC-1793). I'll leave logs + heapdumps in the incident folder. Tagging @emily for customer comms.

derek (eng-runtime): Acknowledged — I'll own follow-ups and the permanent fix. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident resolved (P2) — full recovery at 15:52 UTC. Link to incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1793

sasha (oncall): closing thread, will add timeline to the postmortem draft.
